families.rationale: The card's stated scope is the 'investment banking analyst job family'. Conceptually this sits closest to ma_advisory (the advisory core of the IB analyst role), but the card gives no task-family breakdown, so it cannot tell M&A advisory apart from ECM, DCM or leveraged-finance analyst work. A binding at function_concept depth is plausible under R-CONCEPT. A binding at terminal_task or task_concept depth is not supported by the card.

The card names no partial-coverage limits and no split between sell-side and buy-side facing beyond the implied sell-side IB role. It also names no operational roles that are excluded (such as syndicate execution, capital-markets origination or coverage banking), so a later reader cannot falsify the map against the card alone.

The word 'banking' in 'investment banking' was not treated as licence to bind to treasury_balance_sheet_funding, market risk, trading, operations or buy-side keys. Those keys have a different operational unit of work, so they stay unpromoted. Only the advisory concept is carried forward, and only tentatively.

If the URL and the title citing the IB analyst job family are removed, nothing is left to support any binding. The tentative ma_advisory concept depends entirely on the card's cited scope, and no owner intuition remains after ablation.

An experienced outsider would probably land on ma_advisory at concept level. However, they could reasonably also choose capital_markets_origination_combined, or decline to bind at all, given how coarse 'investment banking analyst' is. The band and the exact key are therefore not reliably reproducible from the card alone.

mappings.rationale: The investment banking analyst job family conceptually includes analyst work for mergers, acquisitions and strategic advisory. This binding is at concept depth only: the card does not list terminal tasks, and it does not rule out the analyst scope also spanning ECM, DCM or leveraged-finance origination. This row is not pooled with any other division.

notes: Sensitivity judge. The single concept-level binding to ma_advisory is tentative, and LIMITS_NAMED fails, so under pass rule public-eval-mapping/intersection-union/v1 this cannot be painted as QUALIFIED_MAPPING. No bindings to capital-markets origination keys were made because the card does not distinguish them.
